introHtml: Black lanyards are a staple for any organization that values a professional, neutral look that complements any uniform or event theme. Whether you need 3/4" woven lanyards for daily ID badge use or antimicrobial options for healthcare settings, black offers a clean backdrop for your logo or text. Perfect for corporate events, trade shows, and schools, these lanyards can be screen printed or embroidered with your branding. Choose from polyester, nylon, or cotton webbing in various widths to match your specific needs.
